headline: Contra finally marches
lede: The cabinet never plays silent — and now neither does ours. CONTRA got its stage bed: two original chiptune marches composed into the store's music engine, cadence-locked to the game's own world clock, with the fortress getting a tritone variation of its own.

notes.text: #3047 (never-dry kick, CONTRA -1 weak): the shelf's toughest run-and-gun played its whole run in SFX-only silence — the only flagship without music. Two ORIGINAL beds in the house idiom (the header law bans transcriptions, and a harness leg proves they're no copy of any bed already on the shelf).

The march is locked to the world clock: one step = exactly 6 ticks, one loop = exactly 24 rifle cadences — gunfire and music can never drift. Loop heat lifts the tempo with the pressure (the loopVoice family); the gate revoices; the help screen ducks; GAME OVER strikes the band so the coin clack owns the over screen.

Referee-clean by construction: zero rng, no hash surface — a twin run maps the bed law over a full autopilot win and hashes byte-identical. 13 new legs, mutants bed-deaf and lift-flat die by name; mutant run 204/204.
Platform: forge-merge's cleanup step aborted after a good merge — mergeclean calls gh pr view with --repo but no PR selector (#3051). The merge shipped clean; cleanup finished by hand.
